verdicts.reason: A is broken: the corner X/slash/circle ornaments are pulled into a row of giant glyphs, the maroon panel sits empty with no text in it, 'Join', 'WADE' and 'team' are split into fragments down the right edge, and the headline is jammed against the top edge over the busy photo. B keeps the original panel composition intact and on brand, but it is just shrunk into a small box in the middle of a mostly empty photo, so the headline and CTA text are small, the panel uses only about a quarter of the canvas, and it was not reworked for the tall format.
